    current_sequence = sequence[:]
    for _ in range(n):
        next_sequence = []
        for i in range(n):
            if i % 2 == 0:
                next_sequence.append((current_sequence[i] + 1) % n)
            else:
                next_sequence.append((current_sequence[i] - 1) % n)
        if next_sequence == list(range(n)):

        current_sequence = next_sequence
    return "No"

def is_real_gears_puzzle(n, gears):
    directions = [1] * n
    for _ in range(1000):  # Simulate pushing the button up to 1000 times
        new_gears = []
        for i in range(n):
            if gears[i] == i:
                return True
            next_teeth = (gears[i] + directions[i]) % n
            new_gears.append(next_teeth)
            directions[i] *= -1  # Switch the direction for the next turn
        gears = new_gears
    return False

def is_real_puzzle(n, gears):
    while True:
        new_gears = [gears[i] + (i % 2 * 2 - 1) * 1 for i in range(n)]
        new_gears = [(x % n) for x in new_gears]
        if new_gears == list(range(n)):
            return 'Yes'
        if new_gears == gears:
            return 'No'
